description.value: Mo-Ment Crispy Burger is a Chinese-style crispy burger fast food restaurant on Granville Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver. It offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment and operates without a drive-through, making it a sit-down-or-grab-and-go stop. Granville Street is a busy urban corridor, putting this spot within easy reach of cyclists navigating the city centre.
